description: Get detailed information about a specific Jira issue by its key (e.g. PROJ-123). Returns summary, status, priority, assignee, reporter, description, labels, dates, comments count, and attachments.

account.description: Optional email address of the connected account to use (e.g. 'user@gmail.com'). If omitted, the default account is used.

name: atlassian-mcp__jira_get_issue
